product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Traditional Woven Globe Pendant Light with White Cloth Cord, 18"H, Natural Willow
product.description: This pendant light will offer a rustic farmhouse feel and add warmth to any area of your home. You can use it to cast a lovely glow over a kitchen table, a bed, a counter, or an island. The natural woven look offers a farmhouse vibe with a modern twist and complements any decor. 18"W x 18"D x 18" H; hanging length: 79.5"H Natural twine shade with a white cloth cord With hints of rustic design, this pendant lamp is ideal for any room in your home. 1 60-watt E26 bulb required; bulb not included Expert installation required For indoor use only
